title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on How to Handle the Commission of a New Crime during the Period of Enforcement of the Supplementary Punishment of Deprivation of Political Rights

articles.content_en: 1. Where a criminal sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment and concurrently to deprivation of political rights commits a new crime during the period of execution of the supplementary punishment of deprivation of political rights after the principal punishment has been fully executed, if the new crime does not require the supplementary punishment of deprivation of political rights, the combined punishment for several crimes shall be imposed in accordance with Article 71 of the Criminal Law.

2. The term of the supplementary punishment of deprivation of political rights that has not been fully executed for the previous crime shall cease to be calculated from the date when the principal punishment of fixed-term imprisonment for the new crime begins to be executed, and shall resume calculation from the date when the principal punishment of fixed-term imprisonment for the new crime is fully executed or from the date of parole, in accordance with the provisions of Article 58 of the Criminal Law; the effect of the supplementary punishment of deprivation of political rights shall apply during the period of execution of the principal punishment for the new crime.

3. Where a criminal sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment commits a new crime during the period of execution of the supplementary punishment of deprivation of political rights after the principal punishment has been fully executed, if the new crime also incurs deprivation of political rights, the combined punishment shall be imposed in accordance with the provisions of Articles 55, 57, and 71 of the Criminal Law.
